widgets_values: Maintain strong consistency of one red-and-black Formula One style open-wheel race car throughout the entire clip. The car has a low aerodynamic body, exposed wheels, a sharp front wing, a clean halo structure, glossy paint, subtle yellow accent lines, and no readable sponsor logos or text. The scene takes place on a modern professional racing circuit at golden hour after light rain. Keep the same car shape, paint colors, track layout, wet asphalt reflections, safety barriers, grandstands, pit wall, tire marks, warm sunlight, thin spray from the tires, and cinematic motorsport atmosphere across all segments. The camera movement should feel fast but readable, with controlled motion blur, stable perspective, realistic tire grip, dramatic reflections, and no sudden impossible jumps. Avoid crashes, broken wheels, distorted car geometry, unreadable text, logos, subtitles, watermark, excessive smoke, chaotic crowd detail, and flickering reflections.

A red-and-black Formula One style race car waits on a wet starting grid at golden hour, low front angle, warm reflections, thin tire mist. | The car launches forward as the lights go out, rear tires throwing fine water spray, camera tracking beside the wheels. | The car enters a wide sweeping corner at high speed, holding a clean racing line, wet asphalt reflecting the golden sky. | Close side tracking shot, spinning wheels, vibrating suspension, glossy bodywork, halo and sidepod catching sunlight. | The car exits the corner onto a long straight, grandstands and pit wall streak softly behind while the car stays sharp. | The car crosses the finish line at full speed, camera rises overhead, wet track reflections and racing line remain clear.

A concise 5-second cinematic LTX-2.3 text-to-video test shot featuring one generic modern open-wheel formula race car, no logos and no brand markings, dark metallic carbon-fiber bodywork, sharp aerodynamic wings, exposed tires, racing on a rugged seaside cliff road above a deep-blue ocean. Keep a single stable car silhouette, physically grounded scale, clean wheel geometry, clear body panels, and readable motion direction. The environment has jagged cliff rocks, wet asphalt, controlled ocean spray, light dust behind the tires, soft mist, and warm golden sunset light. Use a realistic wide-angle tracking camera, high clarity, crisp reflections, moderate shutter-realistic motion blur, restrained debris, stable perspective, and clean cinematic contrast.

Scene 1: The shot opens with a low front-left tracking camera following the same generic formula race car along the seaside cliff road. The car stays sharp and centered, the wet asphalt reflects golden sunset light, and the ocean remains visible far below.

Scene 2: The car reaches a broken cliff edge and launches forward in one clean physically grounded jump. A small controlled trail of dust, gravel, and tire spray follows behind, but the car body, wheels, and wings remain stable and clearly shaped.

Scene 3: The camera widens into a smooth aerial hero angle as the car hangs above the coastline, slightly nose-down, with jagged rocks and deep-blue ocean beneath it. Keep the background simple, the horizon readable, and the car silhouette crisp against the sky.

Scene 4: The camera eases into a rear-quarter follow as the car begins descending toward the sea. Ocean spray rises below, sunset highlights skim across the carbon-fiber body, and the final frame holds the car clearly before impact, with controlled motion blur and no chaotic debris.

[audio_cues]
Clean engine roar, short gravel burst at the cliff edge, wind rush during the jump, distant ocean waves, low cinematic bass rise.
